doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Identifying the Memphis session with Will Shade
summary: The setting moves to Memphis, 225 South 4th Street; Shade, Dewey Corley, Allen and engineer are named and the date given as 25 May 1960.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Do you want to identify? Yeah, I want to identify. Let's see, we're recording today. Yeah, we're recording today in Memphis, Tennessee. What's the address here, man?
Uh-huh. And whose place is this?
This is Miss C. Robinson's place.
Oh yeah, but I mean, what's your name in other words?
And your name? Dewey Colley. I'm Dick Allen. Bill Claxton. Your engineer. And what's today's date, man? I can't remember. May the what?
May the 25th. Uh, 1960. That's right. Okay. Well, let's see. When were you born, man?
